title: Metallurgical Principles
notes: **Metallurgical Principles:** This topic covers the fundamental concepts of metallurgical principles in the chemistry curriculum.
Understanding metallurgical principles is essential for solving problems and building higher-level mathematical skills.
Key definitions and theorems related to metallurgical principles should be memorized and practiced regularly.
